segments.vv48:1.3: Siriyā ca vaṇṇena yasena tejasā, brahmāva deve tidase sahindake.
segments.vv48:2.3: Alaṅkate uttamavatthadhārinī, kā tvaṃ subhe devate vandase mamaṃ.
segments.vv48:3.1: “Kiṃ tvaṃ pure kammamakāsi attanā, manussabhūtā purimāya jātiyā;
segments.vv48:3.3: Dānaṃ suciṇṇaṃ atha sīlasaññamaṃ, kenupapannā sugatiṃ yasassinī;
segments.vv48:4.1: “Idāni bhante imameva gāmaṃ, piṇḍāya amhāka gharaṃ upāgami;
segments.vv48:4.3: Tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacittā atulāya pītiyā;
segments.vv48:5.1: “Sassu ca pacchā anuyuñjate mamaṃ, kahaṃ nu ucchuṃ vadhuke avākirī;
segments.vv48:5.3: Na chaḍḍitaṃ no pana khāditaṃ mayā, santassa bhikkhussa sayaṃ adāsahaṃ.
segments.vv48:6.1: “Tuyhaṃnvidaṃ issariyaṃ atho mama, itissā sassu paribhāsate mamaṃ;
segments.vv48:6.3: Leḍḍuṃ gahetvā pahāraṃ adāsi me, tato cutā kālakatāmhi devatā.
segments.vv48:7.1: “Tadeva kammaṃ kusalaṃ kataṃ mayā, sukhañca kammaṃ anubhomi attanā;
segments.vv48:7.3: Devehi saddhiṃ paricārayāmahaṃ, modāmahaṃ kāmaguṇehi pañcahi.
segments.vv48:8.1: “Tadeva kammaṃ kusalaṃ kataṃ mayā, sukhañca kammaṃ anubhomi attanā;
segments.vv48:8.3: Devindaguttā tidasehi rakkhitā, samappitā kāmaguṇehi pañcahi.
segments.vv48:9.3: Devehi saddhiṃ paricārayāmahaṃ, modāmahaṃ kāmaguṇehi pañcahi.
segments.vv48:10.3: Devindaguttā tidasehi rakkhitā, sahassanettoriva nandane vane.
segments.vv48:11.1: “Tuvañca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañca pucchisaṃ;
segments.vv48:11.3: Tato te ucchussa adāsiṃ khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacittā atulāya pītiyā”ti.
